rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY CT / Non-specific Lower Extremity Pain (1,2)
rules.source_quote: Lower extremity pain with no specific joint identified with MRI contraindicated or cannot be performed AND with prior X-ray

criteria.description: Lower extremity pain without specific localized joint involvement
Prior plain radiographs (X-ray) completed of the symptomatic region
MRI is medically contraindicated or cannot be performed

required_documentation: Plain radiograph report and clinical documentation detailing MRI contraindication (e.g. non-MRI conditional pacemaker, foreign body)
rules.review_notes: Lower extremity CT indication requiring prior X-ray and MRI contraindication.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY CT / Suspected Bone Fracture

criteria.description: Evaluation of complex, intra-articular, or comminuted lower extremity fracture (e.g. tibial plateau, pilon, calcaneus) or nonunion where plain radiographs are insufficient for pre-operative planning

required_documentation: Plain radiograph report demonstrating intra-articular fracture and orthopedic surgical consultation notes
rules.review_notes: Lower extremity CT indicated for complex fracture characterization and surgical reconstruction planning.
